rule_interpretation: Conservative capacity/coverage/stuck-meter flags, not curtailment or meteorological diagnosis; zero runs alone do not exclude a farm.
2024_policy: The 2022/2023 cohort stays fixed. Audit 2024 with the same thresholds later and report sensitivity separately; never choose cohort by model error.
regional_policy: Recompute all nearest and ring inputs from retained farms only, exclude target; 15 minute delay.
